name: general-purpose
description: A capable generalist worker for text tasks that need no specialist — cleaning up, clarifying, reconciling, condensing, or rewriting provided text. Can search and read the stored document corpus to resolve references and ground its work.

skills.name: Clean up and clarify text
skills.description: Tightens and clarifies provided text: resolves cross-references, fixes inconsistencies, and reduces noise while preserving every entity, claim, and decision. May consult the document corpus to resolve ambiguous references.
examples: Tighten this transcription into a clear, unambiguous record
Resolve the cross-references in this note against related documents
Condense this digest without dropping any decisions
